title.rendered: Vancouver AI Community Meetups & BC + AI Ecosystem

content.raw:
Vancouver AI community meetups welcomes all members of the community interested in the future of AI - researchers, artists, geeks, enthusiasts, entrepreneurs, experts, students and more!

Our goal is to build an engaged group through knowledge sharing, collaboration, and discussion of real-world applications and ethical implications of AI.

I'm excited to share something special we've been working on for the Vancouver AI Community. This year, we're hosting a series of meetups designed to dive deep into the world of Artificial Intelligence. Our aim is simple yet ambitious: to create a space where people from all walks of the AI landscape can come together to share knowledge, challenge ideas, and explore the real-world applications and ethical implications of AI.

We're looking forward to a year of meaningful discussions and hands-on learning, with each meetup focusing on a different facet of AI. From the impact of AI on visual storytelling and personal branding to exploring its role in emerging fields like VR and gaming, we're covering a wide spectrum. These sessions are more than just talks; they're collaborative platforms for both seasoned pros and curious newcomers to connect and grow.

Our goal with these meetups is to foster a community that's as diverse as the AI field itself. Whether you're a developer, a researcher, an artist, or just someone fascinated by AI, we want you to be part of this journey. We believe in a straightforward, no-hype approach where the focus is on real value, deep technical insights, and honest discussions. Join us and be part of a conversation that's shaping the future of AI, right here in Vancouver.

Looking forward to seeing you there and diving into these compelling AI topics together.

Big Love to Our Sponsors & Partners

  • Vancouver Biennale: A trailblazer in public art, the Vancouver Biennale transforms the cityscape into an interactive art exhibit.
  • Creative Mornings Vancouver - free monthly breakfast lectures for creatives
  • Holistic Hybrid: A digital strategy powerhouse.
  • Lindsay Bailey Law: Legal expertise with a creative twist.
  • AugXLabs: At the forefront of text-to-video AI.
  • CMPFYR: The digital arena's rising star.
  • Internet Masterminds: A dynamic hub for digital entrepreneurs and online marketers.
  • The FATALE Festival: The FATALE Festival is a beacon for forward-thinking art and technology enthusiasts.

Title: AI Trends & Tools: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date & Time: Thursday, January 25, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Discuss emerging AI technologies and how they’re being applied in various industries and creative fields. Share experiences and get advice from the local AI community.
Target Audience: Anyone interested in AI and its applications
Key Takeaways: Learn about new trends in AI development from local experts and practitioners. Make valuable connections.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/ai-trends


Title: Visual Storytelling with AI: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date & Time: Thursday, February 22, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: This meetup explores how visual storytellers like filmmakers are utilizing AI tools in their work and envisioning future possibilities.
Target Audience: Filmmakers, photographers, visual artists, AI professionals, enthusiasts and anyone interested in AI and its applications.
Key Takeaways: Discussions on tools like DALL-E and Stable Diffusion and their applications; ethical challenges around AI and visual media.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/ai-storytelling

Title: AI Communications Circle: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date & Time: Thursday, March 28, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Discuss effective strategies for communicating AI concepts to different stakeholders and the role of language in human-AI relations.
Target Audience: Writers, communicators, product managers, AI professionals, enthusiasts and anyone interested in AI and its applications.
Key Takeaways: Perspectives on explaining AI to the public and building trust around emerging technologies.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/communications

Title: AI Coding Symposium: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date & Time: Thursday, April 25, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Tech talks and panels on the latest approaches to coding and developing intelligent applications.
Target Audience: Developers, engineers, data scientists, AI professionals, enthusiasts and anyone interested in AI and its applications.
Key Takeaways: Insights on AI frameworks, best practices and upcoming trends in AI programming.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/hacking

Title: AI Social Media & Personal Branding: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date & Time: Thursday, May 30, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Discuss leveraging social platforms and content to establish authority in the AI space. Share challenges and solutions.
Target Audience: Consultants, entrepreneurs, freelancers, AI professionals, enthusiasts and anyone interested in AI and its applications.
Key Takeaways: Tips on creating an online identity and engaging communities through prudent use of AI.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/socialmedia

Title: AI Audio Alchemy: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date & Time: Thursday, June 27, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Discuss AI tools and techniques for audio/music and implications for creators in these fields.
Target Audience: Producers, composers, podcasters, voice professionals, AI professionals, enthusiasts and anyone interested in AI and its applications.
Key Takeaways: Learn how others are crafting AI into audio/aesthetic workflows imaginatively and responsibility.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/ai-music

Title: AI Artistic Evolution: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date: July 25th
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: An evening exploring how AI is shaping the future of art and creativity. Discuss tools, techniques and implications for artists.
Target Audience: Artists, designers, illustrators, photographers, film makers, creative professionals, marketing professionals, community managers.
Key Takeaways: Learn about emerging AI tools and techniques influencing different creative fields.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/ai-artists

Title: Growth Hacking: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date: July 27th
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: A deep dive into innovative AI strategies for hyper-growth and catapulting businesses to the next level.
Target Audience: Entrepreneurs, marketers, business professionals
Key Takeaways: Discover innovative AI-driven growth strategies and case studies. Gain insights on applying AI to marketing, customer acquisition and retention. Learn how startups are leveraging AI to scale rapidly.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/growth-hacking

Title: AI Business Impact: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date: September 26th
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: An enlightening evening exploring the burgeoning impact of Generative AI on business landscapes.
Target Audience: Business leaders, executives, innovators
Key Takeaways: Explore the transformational role of generative AI across various industries. Understand implications and applications for product development, operations, marketing. Discuss best practices for responsible and ethical AI integration.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/AI-meetup

Title: Sustainability & AI: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date: Thursday, October 24, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Discussions on integrating environmental, social and governance priorities into AI strategies.
Target Audience: Sustainability professionals, social impact practitioners
Key Takeaways: Learn how ESG priorities can inform AI strategies and development. Discuss partnering with AI for positive social and environmental impact. Identify opportunities for AI to address sustainability challenges.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/esg

Title: AI in VR & Gaming: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date: November 21st, 224
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: Insights into cutting-edge AI applications and the future of gaming/VR experiences.
Target Audience: Gamers, developers, technologists
Key Takeaways: Demos of cutting-edge AI applications in gaming and immersive experiences. Discuss design considerations and future trends. Explore ethical issues around AI, addiction, realism in digital worlds.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/ai-games

Title: Multimodal AI: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
Date: December 19th, 2024
Location: 290 W 3rd Ave, Vancouver
Description: An exploration of integrating text, image and sound recognition with AI.
Target Audience: Data scientists, UX designers, engineers
Key Takeaways: Understand approaches to integrating text, visual and audio AI systems. Learn challenges and opportunities of multimodal AI. Gain exposure to tools and techniques across industries.
Host: Kris Krüg
Registration Link: https://lu.ma/multimodal

Big Love to Our Sponsors & Partners

  • Vancouver Biennale: A trailblazer in public art, the Vancouver Biennale transforms the cityscape into an interactive art exhibit. Their support empowers us to blend art with technology innovatively. Learn more
  • AugXLabs: At the forefront of augmented reality, AugXLabs brings cutting-edge tech to our events, enhancing the immersive experience. Discover AugXLabs
  • Holistic Hybrid: A digital strategy powerhouse, Holistic Hybrid's expertise in blending creativity with digital know-how elevates our platforms. Explore Holistic Hybrid
  • Lindsay Bailey Law: Legal expertise with a creative twist. Lindsay Bailey provides invaluable legal guidance, ensuring our events and initiatives are on solid ground. Connect with Lindsay Bailey
  • The FATALE Festival: A partner in creativity and innovation, the FATALE Festival is a beacon for forward-thinking art and technology enthusiasts. Visit FATALE Festival
  • CMPFYR: The digital arena's rising star, CMPFYR, brings fresh, tech-driven solutions to our digital strategy, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. About CMPFYR
  • Internet Masterminds: A dynamic hub for digital entrepreneurs and online marketers, Internet Masterminds brings together a community of innovators and disruptors. Discover Internet Masterminds

Partnership Invitation

Join forces with Future Proof Creatives to expand your reach and engage with a thriving community of innovators and creators. Our partnerships are tailored to amplify your brand's presence among an audience passionate about art, technology, and sustainability. Past collaborations have included:

  • Innovative Workshops and Seminars: Co-create unique learning experiences in digital art, technology integration, and sustainable practices.
  • Exclusive Event Sponsorships: Be part of our compelling events like art-tech exhibitions, online forums, and creative meetups.
  • Product Showcases and Launches: Introduce your cutting-edge products to a community eager for innovation.
  • Customized Community Engagements: From think-tank sessions to creative challenges, we offer diverse platforms for meaningful interactions.

If you're keen on partnering with Future Proof Creatives to connect with leading creators, innovators, and thought leaders, reach out to us... Let's create something extraordinary together!

Part of the AI Ethics and Philosophy collection. See also: The Art of Augmented Creativity: Balancing AI, Community, and Self.
